statement: The admitted Guimaraes 2026 hindlimb batch carries both Fmax and PCSA for its 36 Macaca mulatta hindlimb muscles, so sigma_implied = Fmax/PCSA is measured per muscle and taxon-true, and the measured median with its spread can retire the assumed literature constant sigma = 0.3 MPa (30 N/cm^2) used by the interim Fmax-bootstrap and the hind torque book.

prior_sources: docs/research/muscle_physiology_reference.md: vertebrate skeletal average 25-32 N/cm^2 (the myobody value)
Saito 2021 (PMC8693514, CC BY) Table 2: Fmax = PCSA x 23 N/cm^2 (Spector 1980 cat soleus), declared, 'applied to primate hand muscles without validation' by the paper's own wording
docs/research/20260921_arm_architecture_options.md section 2: sigma candidates 23-32 N/cm^2, in-repo posture-cap constant 0.3 MPa (30 N/cm^2) mid-band

predictions.text: IF the batch carries per-muscle Fmax, the measured median sigma_implied over the 36 M. mulatta muscles falls inside 23-32 N/cm^2.
The batch's own closure identities hold per admitted row: PCSA = muscle_mass/(1060 kg/m^3 * FL) within 2%, and muscle mass = belly_mass + tendon_mass within 2%.

Demand-side lower bounds from the admitted Oku 2021 gait simulation paired per muscle with measured PCSA (peak muscle force / PCSA) all fall strictly BELOW 23 N/cm^2: gait demand never exceeds tissue capacity; any bound at or above 23 falsifies the band's lower edge.

falsifiers.name: traceability
falsifiers.text: Every emitted sigma number traces to an admitted batch row, cited as sheet:row with muscle name and the fields used. A sigma that cannot be walked back to rows fires this falsifier.

falsifiers.name: premise
falsifiers.text: The admitted batch bytes must carry an Fmax-bearing field for the derivation to exist. The Macaca mulatta sheet's column set is re-enumerated from the pinned bytes at compute time; ABSENCE of any Fmax-bearing column fires this falsifier, bars the 36-row sigma_implied derivation, and bars retiring the 0.3 MPa constant by measurement.

pre_freeze_status.observation: Reconnaissance before this receipt was frozen (disclosed): workbook sheets and header rows were listed; the Information sheet column dictionary was read; the paper's four table-wrap labels were read. NO per-row statistics over the 36 rows were computed before freeze. The header enumeration shows 13 columns (Species_common, Species, Mus_abbrev, FL_m, PCSA_m2, musc_LENGTH, musc_MASS, belly_LENGTH, belly_MASS, tendon_LENGTH, tendon_MASS, avg_pen_deg, [Limb]) and the dictionary declares exactly these; no Fmax column is declared or present, and the paper's tables are specimen list, muscle list, functional groups, and a PCSA-with/without-pennation t-test - no force data. F2 is ARMED with expected outcome FIRE; the compute script re-verifies from bytes so the firing is measured, not assumed.

falsifiers.name: unit_consistency
falsifiers.text: The sheet headers declare _m/_kg on segment columns whose values are mm/g (the Information dictionary itself mislabels belly_LENGTH_m as 'Muscle belly mass (m)'). The compute script must re-derive the mm/g interpretation row by row via the PCSA closure law (independent of the intake adapter) and must PASS at 2%, or name every contradicting row. It must also decide, per row with pennation present, whether the sheet PCSA is the pennation-uncorrected area (m/(rho*FL)) or the pennation-corrected one (with cos factor), and quantify which convention the column carries - this decides how a PCSA-driven Fmax bootstrap must treat pennate muscles.

falsifiers.name: determinism
falsifiers.text: A second byte-exact re-run of the derivation script must reproduce results.json and audit_table.csv identically (sha256 compared).

falsifiers.name: band_containment
falsifiers.text: IF any measured sigma_implied values materialize (F2 does not fire), their median must sit inside 23-32 N/cm^2; outside, the literature band is falsified for M. mulatta hindlimb and the recommendation changes to the measured band with the literature constant retired anyway (in the direction measured).

inputs.role: architecture batch (PCSA, FL, masses, lengths, pennation)
inputs.ref_cited: 46ed85a3ba1e451cf5b02f068134bf6801dbd258 (intake-muscle: admit Guimaraes 2026 hindlimb architecture + Oku 2021 macaque bipedal series, 2026-09-17)
inputs.pin_provenance: member sha256 pinned in tools/science_funnel/data/guimaraes_arch/download_receipt.json at the same ref; endpoint repackages the outer zip per request, members are stable

inputs.use: Table 3 'Muscle functional groups for each joint in the primate hind limb' - the batch's own taxonomy, not an agent's

inputs.role: demand-side force series for the lower-bound pairing

method_contract: derive_sigma_law.py runs strictly after this receipt exists; it refuses to run if the receipt is missing
sigma is never read from header text; units are resolved only through the row-level closure laws
the M. mulatta sheet rows are the sampling frame; 36 data rows expected (memo 20260920 records 36)
group assignment uses Table 3 of the admitted fulltext verbatim; a muscle listed in two functional groups by Table 3 is BIARTICULAR per source; no agent-invented taxonomy
no file outside tools/science_funnel/validation/sigma_law_20260921/ is created or modified
honesty_notes: The mission premise ('the batch carries BOTH Fmax AND PCSA') is in tension with the reconnaissance; F2 exists precisely so the derivation attempt cannot quietly become a literature constant wearing measured clothes. If F2 fires, the deliverable is the measured quantities the batch DOES carry (PCSA/FL/mass distributions, group structure, pennation convention), the demand-side bounds, and the verdict that 0.3 MPa stays an assumed constant - a red recorded with numbers, not tuned away.

The arm model's 39 Fmax values are FORELIMB and share zero muscles with this hindlimb batch; the forelimb round-trip (Fmax/PCSA) remains blocked by the missing measured PCSA (Cheng & Scott, paywalled), per docs/research/20260921_arm_architecture_options.md - not retried here.
